title: Dunki
desc: Four friends from a small village in Punjab set out on a dangerous journey to reach England without the necessary permits and documents.

title: Jigarwala No. 1
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Barsaat
desc: Badal, a simple village boy, falls for his classmate Tina. However, Tina's father does not approve of their relationship and conspires to separate them.
